n: DCX 3x1 switcher with USB-C, HDMI 2.0 ports (DCX-3x1-TPN-TX10)
d: DCX 3x1 switcher with USB-C, HDMI 2.0 ports. Full 4K HDMI 2.0 TPN transmitter (4K UHD @ 60Hz RGB 4:4:4, up to 18 Gbps). USB-C connectivity for video, audio and charging up to 100W. 10GbE Port for SDVoE network connection with 4K video.
